spec.aud: the repository's Dukascopy AUDUSD is defective in 2008-01..09 and 2009-04..09 (H.10 audit); RV-1 never reads it: Stage 1 uses H.10, Stage 2 and the holdout use AUDJPY/USDJPY
spec.book: weights = centred cross-sectional ranks scaled to sum 0 with gross 2 (one unit long, one short), over the currencies with a score; fewer than 6: no position

classification.PROMISING: Stage 1 gate and Stage 2 net t >= 2 with R1..R8, short of validation
classification.VALIDATED: Stage 1 gate, Stage 2 at its threshold with R1..R8, and the holdout

data.execution: Dukascopy M15 bid/ask (data/manifest.json); AUDUSD synthesised from AUDJPY/USDJPY
data.policy_rates: BIS WS_CBPOL via aitrader/data/rates.py (point in time, staleness rule)

holdout.pass: net mean > 0 with t >= 1.645, and net mean > 0 with costs x2
holdout.policy: RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md section 2: one candidate that passed everything else, once

RV1-H1-CARRY.text: Currencies with higher policy rates outperform lower-rate ones over the next week (cross-sectional carry).

RV1-H2-MOMENTUM.text: Currencies with higher 3- and 12-month relative returns (skipping the last week) outperform over the next week (relative momentum).

RV1-H3-REVERSAL.text: Last week's relative losers outperform last week's winners over the next week.

RV1-H4-VALUE.text: Currencies that fell most against the others over five years outperform over the next week (five-year reversal as a value proxy).

RV1-H5-CARRY-VOL.text: Carry's information differs between low and high global FX volatility.

RV1-H6-MOMENTUM-VOL.text: Momentum's information differs between low and high global FX volatility.

spec.no_sizing: weights are fractions of a notional; sizing, limits and execution remain the Risk Engine's
spec.question: Does a cross-sectional ranking of eight currencies (carry, relative momentum, one-week reversal, five-year reversal, and carry/momentum by global FX volatility) predict the next week's RELATIVE returns -- and, if so, does a currency-neutral book survive realistic costs, robustness and the sealed holdout?
spec.regime: global FX volatility = mean |daily log change| of the seven currencies against USD over the last 20 changes usable at the decision; HIGH if above the median of the previous (up to 156, at least 52) weekly values, else LOW

signals.carry: policy rate (percent); a currency without one is excluded that week, never filled
signals.momentum: mean of the cross-sectional ranks of the log change over 91 and 364 days ending at the last fixing >= 7 days before the last usable fixing (skip one week)
signals.reversal: minus the log change over the last 7 days to the last usable fixing
signals.value: minus the log change over the last 1820 days (five years) to the last usable fixing

stage1.candidate: signal hypothesis: its signal in the direction of its mean IC; regime hypothesis: its signal traded only in the regime with the higher mean IC (in that IC's direction), no position in the other
stage1.gate_regime: |t| >= 2.807, >= 50 weeks in each regime, the LOW-minus-HIGH difference has the same sign in both halves
stage1.gate_signal: |t| >= 2.807, >= 100 weeks, the mean IC has the same sign in both halves of the period, leaving out any one currency never flips the sign, and the currency-neutral book's gross mean has the same sign
stage1.multiple_testing: Bonferroni at 5% two-sided over the registry's 4 earlier tests on 2000-01..2007-03 plus these 6
stage1.reported: weeks, mean/sd IC, t, IC by year and half, leave-one-currency-out, without the most favourable week, 1%-trimmed mean, book gross mean/t/Sharpe, contribution by currency, book without its 5 best weeks
stage1.statistic: weekly Spearman IC between the score (literature sign: + = expected to outperform) and the next week's relative returns, >= 6 currencies; t = mean IC / (sd / sqrt(weeks)); H5/H6: Welch t of mean IC in LOW minus HIGH

controls.abstention: hold the book only when the signal's raw cross-sectional dispersion is >= the median of its previous (up to 156, >= 52) weekly values; else flat
controls.null_for_price_signals: 1000 random rank books (weekly permutations, seed 20261004): candidate gross mean > their 95th percentile
controls.price_only_for_carry: the momentum book (H2 definition) under the same regime gating: OLS alpha of the candidate's gross weekly return on it, t >= 2.0

costs.financing: position x (its policy rate - USD policy rate) x days/360, minus the markup on gross exposure
costs.spread: measured at the execution bar, half paid on every change of position

stage2.execution: rebalance at the H.10 entry fixing time (noon New York, first business day after the Friday) on Dukascopy M15 bid/ask (the bar closing then, else the nearest within 60 minutes; any missing pair -> no rebalance that week); AUDUSD = AUDJPY/USDJPY (bid = AUDJPY bid / USDJPY ask, ask = AUDJPY ask / USDJPY bid)
stage2.pass: net mean > 0 with t >= the Stage-2 threshold and R1..R8 -> holdout eligible (the best by t only); net mean > 0, t >= 2.0 and R1..R8 -> PROMISING; else REJECTED

robustness.R2_years: >= 60% of years with >= 26 weeks net positive
robustness.R3_concentration: no currency carries > 50% of the gross P&L, and leaving out any one currency keeps the net mean > 0
robustness.R4_outliers: net mean > 0 without the 5 best weeks
robustness.R5_costs: net mean > 0 with spread, slippage and commission x2
robustness.R6_execution: net mean > 0 when every rebalance is one business day later
robustness.R7_regimes: net mean not significantly negative (t > -2) in either volatility regime

stage2.threshold: bonferroni over the registry's tests on 2008-07..2017-01 plus the number of candidates, computed when RV-1-S2 is registered
stage2.universe_rule: a currency without a policy rate at the decision is excluded from every Stage-2 book that week (its financing cannot be priced; never filled)

timing.forward: from the first H.10 fixing after the Friday to the first fixing >= 7 days later (<= 10 days, else the week is skipped)
timing.information: H.10 rates with available_at <= decision (the next business day 17:00 New York after their date); policy rates public at the decision

spec.transformations: value of each currency in USD (USD = 1); log; relative return = return minus the mean of the eight; only dates on which all seven H.10 rates exist
